evidenceModel.de: Der konkrete gemeinsame Rechenauftrag verlangt bedeutungshaltige Stoffmengen mit eindeutiger Einheit mol. Das bestehende Ziel1dc mit ganzem aktuellen P klärt benannte Elementarteilchen, Molekül-/Atom-/Ionen-/Formeleinheitenbezug und die Grenze gleicher Stoffmenge gegenüber gleicher Masse. Dies ist eine passende Erwerbsgrundlage des bereits direkt abhängigen Titrationsziels02634. Dessen ganzes P lehrt die formale analytische Stoffmenge je ursprünglichem Probenvolumen und fordert eine begründete stöchiometrische Auswertung.
evidenceModel.en: The concrete common calculation demand requires meaningful amounts of substance expressed unambiguously in mol. Existing goal1dc and its whole current profile establish specified entities, molecule/atom/ion/formula-unit reference and the distinction between equal amounts and equal masses. This is a suitable acquisition foundation for already directly dependent titration goal02634. Its whole profile develops formal analytical amount per original sample volume and requires justified stoichiometric evaluation.

actualPresentTransfer.foundation: O2/He equal entity amounts versus constituent O-atom amounts and unequal masses; fresh NaCl ionic-lattice case distinguishes formula units, each ion kind and combined-ion amount. No numerical Avogadro calculation is required by these actual two cases.
actualPresentTransfer.dependent: Four whole current cases retain planning, supervised actual conduct, reaction/indicator transfer, acquired concentration reference, fresh aliquot and diprotic dilution/back-calculation. Paper-data cases explicitly provide no learner execution evidence.
actualPresentTransfer.boundedConclusion: The source calculation bullet supports teaching the existing mole foundation in this MV route; it does not independently require each foundation entity example, cover all masses/calculation skills, or prove any learner mastered or performed them.
